FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 338
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Kenyatté Hassell
Analyst: Michael Russo Date: 02/26/2026
House Bill 338 as introduced would provide a 4% cost-of-living increasing, not less than $15
per month, to the monthly retirement benefits of certain retirees and beneficiaries of the
Employees' Retirement System (ERS) of the Retirement Systems of Alabama (RSA), including
the state police plan, effective October 1, 2026, subject to legislative funding.
According to RSA, this, increase would provide an average annual benefit increase of $1,060
per retiree/beneficiary for an estimated 24,077 retirees/beneficiaries. The costs associated with
this increase are shown in the table below:

be required to fully fund the increased contribution rate.
